orbs.note: Eightco Holdings (NASDAQ: ORBS) common stock. 100,655,143 shares per Bitmine's 10-Q (May 31, 2026, Note on Investment in Eightco: beneficially owned after the March 12, 2026 purchase). Bitmine's weekly releases report only the $ value (e.g. $76M on Oct 25 ≈ 100.66M × $0.755).

assumptions.weekly_staking_yield_source: Bitmine's stated 7-day BMNR yield in the 2026-10-26 release.

valuation.source: Scenario inputs originally from the group's spreadsheet (rows 19-36). Bear ETH staked = latest reported staked ETH; base = all ETH held; bull = 6,105,000.

share_estimation.weekly_cash_opex_source: 10-Q quarter ended May 31, 2026: (G&A $37.270M − share-based comp $0.648M + cost of sales $5.726M) ÷ 13 weeks. Staking rewards are received in ETH and are already inside reported ETH holdings, so they are not a cash inflow here.
share_estimation.bmnp_weekly_dividend_source: 3,500,000 BMNP shares (June 10, 2026 offering) × $0.1847 regular weekly dividend (dividend schedule, 8-K Aug 14, 2026).
share_estimation.issue_price: average BMNR daily close over the week (range bounds use the week's highest / lowest close)
share_estimation.purchase_price: average daily ETH price over the week (CoinGecko)
share_estimation.staking_rewards: ETH staked at the previous report × that week's stated 7-day BMNR yield × days/365

reference_prices.note: As-of 2026-10-25: ETH per release, BTC CoinGecko, BMNR close 2026-10-23, ORBS = reported stake ÷ shares held.

last_week.notes: Buyback 2.04M shares at $22.48 (disclosed). 2026 total: 22.9M shares, avg $17.48, $399.6M. +22,620 shares from director RSU vesting Oct 23 (Form 4s).

shares_official.source: Form 10-Q for quarter ended May 31, 2026 (cover page), filed 2026-07-14
shares_official.next_expected: Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended Aug 31, 2026 (not yet filed as of Oct 26, 2026); afterwards a 10-KT for Sep 1–Dec 31, 2026 (fiscal year-end changed to Dec 31 per 8-K of Jul 13, 2026).
